topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I was scrolling through my messages, catching up on chats, when I noticed a new comment from Alex, a friend I've known for a couple of years online. We've shared countless memes and deep conversations, but today's message was different. "Hey, I'm actually in town this weekend, maybe we can grab coffee?" I read it over a few times, my finger hovering over the reply button. It's one thing to chat with someone online, but to think we could meet in person, right here in the very city I call home, seems like a twist of fate. I reread the message, a smile spreading across my face. Could this really be happening?
